descriptions.w3d_named_suffix_802b1510: Copies the incoming name into a local string, parses an optional colon-separated numeric suffix and truncates the copied name, resolves a handle through 0x8015adf4, preserves negative errors, applies a nonzero suffix as a byte to the resolved object, and destroys the local string on both paths. Constructor and callback identities are bound from original instructions; semantic names inferred.
